skyline-alice-s-pacific-return.title: Skyline · Alice’s · Pacific Return
skyline-alice-s-pacific-return.slogan: Redwoods, ridge roads and ocean air.

scenicChapters.title: Alice’s Restaurant area → Pescadero coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 42 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

skyline-alice-s-pacific-return.storyWas: Redwoods, ridge roads and ocean air.

scenicChapters.title: Kaza → Kunzum Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 8.1%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.title: Kunzum Pass → Manali
scenicChapters.narrative: 4551 m come off over 68 km at around 8.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

spiti-valley-circuit.story: 485 km from Shimla to Manāli, about 7 h 03 of riding. On the way it passes Reckong Peo, Nako, Kaza and Kunzum Pass. The highest point is about 5,050 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
